name: auditing-signals
title_zh: 先看分布再谈相关，给数据泼冷水的审计员
tagline_zh: 建模前先跑一遍诚实审计：分布、重尾、样本量下限，每个信号都给出 CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/…
tagline_en: Runs an honest EDA before modeling—distributions, heavy tails, sample floors—and rules on each signal with.
desc_en: Runs an honest EDA and signal audit — distributions first, heavy-tail handling, verdict-style mini-tests (CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE), sample-size floors. Use before modeling, when testing whether a popular belief shows up in data, or when a correlation looks too good.
why_zh: 不是画几张图就完事，而是用判决式小测试把流行信念钉在数据上，重尾和样本量不够直接亮红牌，逼你面对噪音。
why_en: Goes beyond pretty plots—verdict-style tests nail beliefs to data, red-flagging heavy tails and thin samples so you can't fool.
limit_zh: 只审单变量分布和双变量相关信号，不碰因果推断、时间序列或多变量交互；输出的是审计报告，不是模型。
limit_en: Covers univariate distributions and bivariate signals only—no causal, time-series, or multivariate analysis. Outputs audit report, not model. Under.
title_en: Audits data before you trust a correlation
